CIL-C1.prior: higher membership fanout/shared mechanism may create later propagation savings; heterogeneity, redundant pre-existing boundaries and low future demand may reverse the sign
CIL-C1.authority_ceiling: one real paired-demand world may update the support-domain map but may not validate a universal design law

CBL-C1.prior: when an existing abstraction requires capabilities absent from real demand, reuse can impose truthful conformance burden; segregation may reduce it only if coordination costs do not erase the mechanism
CBL-C1.mechanism_support: C_WIDE,0>C_SEG,0 and C_WIDE,1>C_SEG,1 with all Q=1
CBL-C1.counterevidence: wide reuse has no additional C burden in either real phase, or the mismatch is shown not to exist
CBL-C1.interpretation: S/L/A remain co-equal coordinates; C reduction alone never authorizes a design winner

pareto: report phasewise vector Pareto relation over S/L/C/A only; never convert to scalar score or overall winner
